frontier_deploy.stdout:
usage: frontier_deploy.py [-h]
                          {validate,render,preflight,plan,deploy,upgrade-runtime,build-images,smoke,verify,seed-tasks,upgrade-local-network,gpu-smoke,apply} ...

Guarded fresh-account installer for the executable FrontierCS2 Preview
profile. The site file is deliberately non-secret. AWS CLI, Terraform, Docker,
and kubectl receive credentials through their ordinary local credential
chains.

positional arguments:
  {validate,render,preflight,plan,deploy,upgrade-runtime,build-images,smoke,verify,seed-tasks,upgrade-local-network,gpu-smoke,apply}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

reference_parity.stdout:
usage: reference_parity.py [-h] (--task TASK | --all)
                           --management-url MANAGEMENT_URL [--config CONFIG]
                           [--catalog CATALOG] [--seed-receipt SEED_RECEIPT]
                           [--mirrors MIRRORS] --receipt RECEIPT
                           [--attempt ATTEMPT] [--poll-seconds POLL_SECONDS]

Replay native reference overlays against seeded Preview tasks, resumably.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task TASK
  --all
  --management-url MANAGEMENT_URL
  --config CONFIG
  --catalog CATALOG
  --seed-receipt SEED_RECEIPT
  --mirrors MIRRORS     default: task-images.json beside the seed receipt
  --receipt RECEIPT
  --attempt ATTEMPT
  --poll-seconds POLL_SECONDS

build_demo_images.stdout:
usage: build_demo_images.py [-h]
                            [--problem {all,cpu,batch_local_counting,bounded_evm_path_prediction,evm_state_checkpoints,graph_mining_method_selection,join_tree_rewriting,sparse_video_attention_policy}]
                            [--image-prefix IMAGE_PREFIX]
                            [--manifest MANIFEST] [--push]
                            [--incremental-from INCREMENTAL_FROM]
                            [--crane CRANE]

Build the bundled CPU and native GPU demo images locally. This entrypoint
deliberately has no AWS, Kubernetes, registry-login, or secret handling. A
push is opt-in and relies on the operator's existing Docker credential
configuration without reading or copying it.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --problem {all,cpu,batch_local_counting,bounded_evm_path_prediction,evm_state_checkpoints,graph_mining_method_selection,join_tree_rewriting,sparse_video_attention_policy}
  --image-prefix IMAGE_PREFIX
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --push                push after verification; never performs docker login
  --incremental-from INCREMENTAL_FROM
                        verify this previous Git commit and plan source-only
                        OCI layers; --push publishes them
  --crane CRANE         crane executable for optional incremental publication

resolve_catalog_digests.stdout:
usage: resolve_catalog_digests.py [-h] [--catalog CATALOG] [--task TASK]

Resolve public Docker Hub tags to linux/amd64 digests; no Docker or
credentials. All reads finish and validate before the catalog is rewritten.
Authentication uses only Docker Hub's anonymous pull grant, held in memory and
never logged.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --catalog CATALOG
  --task TASK        resolve only this task; leave all other pins unchanged
